acceptance: Correct one-shot frozen held-out comparison and independent metric audit; preserve negative, unavailable and inconclusive methods. No clinical accuracy threshold or guaranteed improvement.
attempt_policy: One fresh supervised attempt per phase; separate root-authored release binds exact committed source and prerequisites. Preserve every failed stage; no automatic retry.
coordinate_convention: Creator paired-world-mm convention: first triplet before-US, second during-US; each original NIfTI sform maps voxel centres to RAS millimetres. Identity conversions express that convention, not anatomical registration accuracy.
frame_failure_policy: Reject any actual header outside the frozen rule before B; no trial flips, affine replacement, registration or destination-informed correction.
holdout_consequence: V remains unopened until this declared evaluation. Afterwards it cannot be called untouched validation for newly selected or tuned FEM or other methods; Case4 stays DEVELOPMENT.
memory_policy: Bounded header and landmark inputs; report worker ru_maxrss, without claiming a hard RSS limit.
partition_policy: Preserve existing source-only farthest-point partition; no replacement, outlier removal, V tuning or reallocation.
prediction_freeze: Complete evaluable fields before joint evaluator V-source/destination reveal; no claim of presampled V predictions.
previous_experiments: Preserve all earlier Case4 mesh/alignment failures, unaccepted MRI registration and ReMIND negative result. This study claims none of their acceptance gates.
primary_comparison: proper_rigid versus no_shift on all available held-out V rows
secondary_comparison: fixed inverse_distance_squared; report every pairwise comparison without V-selected method promotion
